mapper.select: INSERT INTO import_batch (file_name, model_threshold, applied_threshold, rows_read, rows_inserted, rows_skipped, alarms_created, imported_by) OUTPUT INSERTED.batch_id VALUES (#{fileName}, #{modelThreshold}, #{appliedThreshold}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{importedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE import_batch SET rows_read = #{rowsRead}, rows_inserted = #{rowsInserted}, rows_skipped = #{rowsSkipped}, alarms_created = #{alarmsCreated}, data_from = #{dataFrom, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, data_to = #{dataTo, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
